summary: Owner-facing provider intelligence panel (observed model identity with provenance, behaviour metrics, epoch timeline, routing explanations, episode drill-down) plus learning controls and a single wiring facade
implementation: src/shared/provider-intelligence.ts: pure, JSON-safe projection — ProviderIntelligencePanel (controls/providers/modelSnapshots/epochs/routing), ProviderPanelRow (observed model + source + confidence + provenance, epoch, sample count, metrics, strong signals, recent changes), ModelTimelineEntry, EpochTimelineEntry, LearningControlStateView; strongSignalsOf (only meaningful signals: confident low completion, strong completion, elevated restriction, degraded runtime reliability, low verification pass, large concept deviations); buildEpisodeDrilldown (marks whether an episode may feed the semantic profile)

electron/learning/learning-service.ts: LearningService facade wiring flags + episodes + snapshots + epochs + profiles + concepts + feedback ledger + promotion gate + observer/evaluator/scorer; recordEpisode, rebuildDerived, resetDerived (episodes preserved), setAdaptiveRouting (A37: learning continues), setLearning (kill switch, cached profiles remain readable), panel(), drilldown(), controlState(); every method failure-isolated

Wiring: main.ts lazily creates LearningService under userData/.boss/learning and exposes boss:provider-intelligence, boss:learning-episode, boss:learning-control (rebuild|reset|set-adaptive-routing|set-learning); preload bridge + BossBridge contract methods; renderer ProviderIntelligence panel (collapsed toggle in the header) with metrics, provenance, epochs, routing explanation and episode drill-down; styles appended
Panel rendering only shows observed numbers with n/confidence alongside — never a bare fabricated score.
tests: tests/unit/engine-phase-11.test.ts (9 tests): provider projection (metrics, OBSERVED provenance for a structured model id, UNKNOWN + undefined observedModelId for an unobserved provider, strong completion / low completion signals); epoch timeline with parent link and open/closed; drill-down marks profile-contributing vs runtime-fault episodes; strong signals empty for an unobserved profile; rebuild produces profiles and reset keeps episodes then rebuilds again; A37 adaptive routing disabled while learning continues (episodes still recorded); learning disabled keeps cached profiles readable and stops new evaluations; panel failure-isolation with a corrupt store (degraded reason, no throw); control state reports stable policy + counts
